trust_decision.summary: CBvideo::update_video decides which video row an edit applies to from caller-supplied videoid; existence is checked with an int cast and ownership with a quoted mysql_clean compare, but the final UPDATE WHERE clause concatenates the raw videoid inside quotes, so the identity checked and the identity written differ.

landing_point.why: Summary names the videoid parameter of video edit; grepping videoid in update_video leads straight to the raw string concatenation in the UPDATE condition.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST actions/file_uploader.php (updateVideo, videoid) -> CBvideo::update_video; also POST admin_area/edit_video.php (update) and POST edit_video.php?vid= (update_video)
same as above (same function, final UPDATE)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the marker route: it is a different parameter (location/title values, not videoid), the values are escaped by Clipbucket_db::update, and a global request filter already strips the |no_mc| and |f| markers, so it looks already defended and outside a videoid advisory.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Internal callers deliberately pass |no_mc| / |f| prefixed values through Clipbucket_db::update (e.g. view counters, NOW(), pre-escaped values from clean_func paths in update_video itself); a fix that removes marker handling in the DB layer or escapes everything breaks these, and casting/stripping the edit fields over-broadly breaks legitimate titles/descriptions.

O6_input_shapes: scalar string videoid from POST (actions/file_uploader.php, admin_area/edit_video.php)
mysql_clean-escaped GET vid copied into POST videoid (upload/edit_video.php:20,30)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Edit-form field values (e.g. location) reach the same UPDATE's SET clause; a value carrying the |no_mc| marker skips Clipbucket_db escaping, and the global marker strip is a single non-recursive preg_replace pass, so a nested marker reassembles after stripping.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not the videoid parameter named in the advisory; the request filter appears to already strip markers and the DB layer appears to escape values.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Strip in ClipBucket.class.php, bypass check in db.class.php:327-339, field definitions in upload.class.php:677-687; three files away from the landing point in video.class.php

O8b_injection_room.sibling: update_photo builds the same UPDATE with raw photo_id inside quotes (" photo_id='$pid'"); a planted copy for photos/collections edit would be the same mechanism in a second implementation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: update_photo is a near-copy of update_video (same field loop, same |no_mc| clean_func idiom at photos.class.php:2379); a maintainer copying the edit flow would carry the raw id concat.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: is_video_owner compares a quoted mysql_clean string to an int column, while getOne casts to int: a check/use identity differential that could be planted on another edit path that trusts is_video_owner then uses the raw id.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The codebase mixes (int) casts, quoted mysql_clean and raw concat for ids in the same flows (video.class.php:402 vs :2730 vs :1972).

O9_family: SQL injection (CWE-89), id parameter concatenated into a WHERE clause, with an identity differential between the existence/ownership checks and the write

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.x with mysqli, Composer vendor tree checked in under upload/vendor
O10_build.project_tests: none found (no tests directory in the pinned tree)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Cast videoid to int at the UPDATE line only (or wrap it in mysql_clean), leaving the edit-field values' marker bypass into the same UPDATE untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: Many other raw id concatenations in WHERE clauses exist in other classes (e.g. upload/includes/classes/user.class.php:3896, upload/includes/classes/lang.class.php:309, upload/includes/classes/cbemail.class.php:134); different sinks, not pursued.
upload/includes/classes/upload.class.php:171 writes caller-supplied userid into the video insert during upload; authorization concern, not pursued.
unverified: O8 marker route is from static reading only: not confirmed that validate_video_upload_form (upload/includes/classes/upload.class.php) leaves location unvalidated, nor default value of config enable_location_video_field.

Whether clean_requests (upload/includes/classes/ClipBucket.class.php:91) runs for every entry point (e.g. actions/file_uploader.php) was inferred from its call in the ClipBucket constructor, not traced.
Front-office upload/edit_video.php passes a mysql_clean-escaped vid, so it likely is not exploitable for this flaw; counted as an entry point that reaches the code.
Repo size not measured (no shell); tiny_repo/giant_repo not assessed.
Latest release not provided; present_in_latest left unknown.
